attempts.reason: OperationalError: unable to open database file

kind: pre-series integration defect — no provider call was made, no slot consumed
note: The driver read a field the preflight report did not carry. Three bounded infrastructure attempts failed before launch, each costing nothing. The hermeticity rule identity the preregistration bound is unchanged — the repair records it on the report rather than altering it. A second defect then appeared in the field: the executor leaves its database in write-ahead mode, so the extracted copy could not be opened without the log left behind. That attempt did reach the provider — 27 model calls and 49 tool calls — and its $0.0155 is counted against the qualification ceiling. Extraction now checkpoints before copying, and usage is recorded whenever a session exists so a later failure cannot lose what was spent.
